title: Constructing a nuanced argument / Koma yango na makomami mpe mibeko
bridge: Na anglais, koma yango na makomami ekomiwaka na nzela ya mbala na sima ya ngalasemi ya degré (p. ex., 'somewhat', 'arguably'), mitobo ya modal ya déduction (p. ex., 'might', 'could'), mpe na ntina ya ba clauses ya concession (p. ex., 'although', 'while'). Na ndenge ya esika ya espagnol, kasi na ndenge ya subjonctif (aunque sea, quizás sea) bazalaka na ntina, anglais ekoki malamu na ordre ya ba mot ya ye mpe na ba marqueur discursif. Molongo monene moko ezali kotinda bandako na bandako ya espagnol koti 'aunque pudiera ser', yango na anglais ekomiwaka malamu na 'although it could be' to 'while it might be'.
rule: Koma yango na makomami na anglais na niveau C1, kosalela: 1) Ba ngalasemi ya attitude (p. ex., 'arguably', 'apparently', 'probably') koti kozonga position ya moti. 2) Mitobo ya modal ya possibilité (might, may, could) koti kozonga degré ya certitude. 3) Ba connecteur ya concession (although, even though, while, whereas) koti kozonga ba contre-arguments. 4) Ba structures koti 'it could be argued that...', 'one might say that...', 'this is not to say that...' koti kozonga makomami. Koluka ordre ya syntaxe: na anglais, concession ekoki kozala na début to na fin, kasi ezali na bokasi kozala na entre sujet na verbe na ndenge moko moko na espagnol. Kobenga kozala na ntina ya 'maybe' (na ndenge ya oral) na contexte ya formel; kopesa 'perhaps' to 'possibly'.

concept_examples.text: Although it could be argued that the policy has benefits, its long-term effects remain uncertain.
concept_examples.translation: Ata kasi tokoki koloba politique ezali na makasi, effet ya ye na long terme bazali na doute.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɔːlˈðəʊ ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːɡjuːd ðæt ðə ˈpɒləsi hæz ˈbenɪfɪts, ɪts ˈlɒŋtɜːm ɪˈfekts rɪˈmeɪn ʌnˈsɜːtən/

concept_examples.text: While this approach seems reasonable, one might question its practicality in real-world scenarios.
concept_examples.translation: Ata kasi approche oyo ekomiwaka na raison, moko tokoki kozwa doute na pratique na ba scénario ya monde réel.
concept_examples.phonetic: /waɪl ðɪs əˈprəʊʧ siːmz ˈriːzənəbl, wʌn maɪt ˈkwestʃən ɪts ˌpræktɪˈkæləti ɪn rɪəl wɜːld sɪˈnɑːriəʊz/

concept_examples.text: The evidence is compelling; nevertheless, one should not overlook the counterarguments.
concept_examples.translation: Preuve ezali ya poids; kasi, tokoki kozwa ba contre-arguments.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈevɪdəns ɪz kəmˈpelɪŋ; ˌnevəðəˈles, wʌn ʃʊd nɒt ˌəʊvəˈlʊk ðə ˈkaʊntərˌɑːɡjʊmənts/

concept_examples.text: It could be said that the proposal, though well-intentioned, fails to address the root cause.
concept_examples.translation: Tokoki koloba proposition oyo, ata kasi ezali na bonne intention, ekoki kozala na problème na cause ya base.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd bi ˈsed ðæt ðə prəˈpəʊzəl, ðəʊ ˌwelɪnˈtenʃənd, feɪlz tu əˈdres ðə ruːt kɔːz/

common_error.wrong: Although it could be possible, but I doubt it.
common_error.correct: Although it could be possible, I doubt it.
common_error.correct_alt: It could be possible, but I doubt it.
common_error.explanation: Na espagnol, 'aunque... pero' ekomiwaka na ntina koti kozonga concession, kasi na anglais ezali na bokasi kosalela 'although' na 'but' na ndenge moko. Kosalela moko kaka. Mpe 'aunque' ekomiwaka na ndenge ya 'although'/'though' na début, mpe 'but' ekomiwaka koti kozonga contraste na sima ya ba clause ya principal.

levels.label: Adverbs of stance
levels.translation: Ba ngalasemi ya attitude

examples.original: Arguably, the most significant factor is economic stability.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɑːrɡjuəbli, ðə məʊst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈfæktə ɪz ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk stəˈbɪləti/
examples.translation: Tokoki koloba facteur ya poids ezali stabilité économique.
examples.note: 'Arguably' ekomiwaka na début to na entre ba virgule; na espagnol ekomiwaka na 'podría decirse que'.

examples.original: The results are presumably accurate, but we need to verify them.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑː prɪˈzjuːməbli ˈækjʊrət, bʌt wi niːd tu ˈverɪfaɪ ðəm/
examples.translation: Résultat bazali na précision, kasi tokoki kozwa vérification.
examples.note: 'Presumably' ekomiwaka supposition na base; kobenga kozwa confusion na 'probably'.

examples.original: Apparently, the committee has reached a consensus.
examples.phonetic: /əˈpærəntli, ðə kəˈmɪti hæz riːʧt ə kənˈsensəs/
examples.translation: Na ndenge ya preuve, comité ekomiwaka na accord.

levels.label: Modals of deduction
levels.translation: Mitobo ya déduction

examples.original: She might have overlooked the details, but the overall conclusion is sound.

examples.note: 'Might have + participe' ekomiwaka possibilité ya passé.

examples.original: The data could be interpreted differently if we change the assumptions.

examples.translation: Donnée tokoki kozwa interprétation ya ndenge moko si tozonga hypothèse.
examples.note: 'Could' ekomiwaka possibilité ya condition.

examples.original: The project may succeed if the funding is secured.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɒʤekt meɪ səkˈsiːd ɪf ðə ˈfʌndɪŋ ɪz sɪˈkjʊəd/
examples.translation: Projet peut avoir succès si financement ekomiwaka.
examples.note: 'May' ezali ya formel; na anglais ya parole, 'might' to 'could' bazali na ntina.

levels.label: Concessive structures
levels.translation: Ba structures ya concession

examples.original: Even though the plan is flawed, it offers a starting point for discussion.
examples.phonetic: /ˈiːvən ðəʊ ðə plæn ɪz flɔːd, ɪt ˈɒfəz ə ˈstɑːtɪŋ pɔɪnt fɔː dɪˈskʌʃən/
examples.translation: Ata kasi plan ezali na défaut, ezali na début ya discussion.
examples.note: 'Even though' ezali na poids ya plus ya 'although'.

examples.note: 'Whereas' ekomiwaka koti kozonga ba idée na ba phrase ya complexe.

examples.original: However compelling the argument may be, we must consider the practical implications.

examples.note: Structure 'However + adjectif + sujet + verbe' koti kozonga makomami.

title: Critical Analysis and Evaluation / Analisi na evaluasion ya mikapo
bridge: Na español, tozali kozonga evaluasion ya critique na ba lokuta oyo ezali 'me parece que', 'es importante señalar' to 'subjuntivo'. Na anglais, molakisi ezali kosala na ba verbe modaux (may, might, could) mpo na kopesa ba niveau ya certitude, ba adverbe ya degré (highly, somewhat, arguably) na ba structure ya opinion impersonnel (It is worth noting). Mokolo mobimba ezali kosalela 'must' mpo na noko malamu na español ezali 'debe ser', kasi na anglais 'must' ezali komonisa likambo ya logique ya nguya, te posibilité. Likambo moko mpe ezali ya solo mpo na koyekola kopesa ba nuance te kosala bato kozonga: na anglais tozali kosalela 'I would argue' na esika ya 'I think definitely'.
rule: Mpo na kosala evaluasion ya critique na anglais na niveau C1, salela: 1) Ba verbe modaux mpo na ba degré ya certitude: 'must' (certitude), 'may/might/could' (posibilité), 'can't' (impossibilité). 2) Ba adverbe ya degré: 'highly', 'extremely', 'somewhat', 'arguably', 'undoubtedly'. 3) Ba structure impersonnel: 'It is worth noting that...', 'It could be argued that...', 'The evidence suggests...'. 4) Ba verbe ya opinion: 'I would argue', 'I contend', 'I maintain' (plus formel que 'I think'). 5) Ba connecteur ya contraste: 'however', 'nevertheless', 'whereas'. Boya kozonga 'I think' mingi na écriture académique; boya 'This implies that...' to 'It could be inferred that...'. Mpo na evaluasion, salela 'strengths and weaknesses', 'implications', 'limitations'.

concept_examples.text: While the author makes a compelling case, the argument fails to address the economic implications.
concept_examples.translation: Ata auteur azali kopesa mokano oyo ezali na bosembo, mokano yango te ezali kosala na ba implications économiques.
concept_examples.phonetic: waɪl ði ˈɔːθər meɪks ə kəmˈpelɪŋ keɪs, ði ˈɑːrɡjumənt feɪlz tə əˈdres ði ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪkl ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃənz

concept_examples.text: It could be argued that the proposed solution is not sustainable in the long term.
concept_examples.translation: Tózali kosala mokano oyo esalemi ezali na bosembo, kasi solution oyo esalemaki te ezali na bosembo mpo na ntango ya lokola.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːrɡjud ðæt ðə prəˈpoʊzd səˈluːʃən ɪz nɑːt səˈsteɪnəbl ɪn ðə lɔːŋ tɜːrm

concept_examples.text: The evidence suggests that the policy has had limited impact, if any.
concept_examples.translation: Ba preuve ezali komonisa ete politique ezali na effet ya limité, ata kaka efungolami.
concept_examples.phonetic: ði ˈevɪdəns səˈdʒests ðæt ðə ˈpɑːləsi hæz hæd ˈlɪmɪtɪd ˈɪmpækt, ɪf ˈeni

concept_examples.text: One might question the validity of the study, given its small sample size.
concept_examples.translation: Tózali kosala mokano oyo esalemi ezali na bosembo, kasi étude yango ezali na ba problème mpo na taille ya ba exemple oyo esalemi.
concept_examples.phonetic: wʌn maɪt ˈkwestʃən ðə vəˈlɪdəti əv ðə ˈstʌdi, ˈɡɪvən ɪts smɔːl ˈsæmpəl saɪz

common_error.wrong: I think that the author is right, but the article is not good because it doesn't have examples.
common_error.correct: While the author makes a valid point, the article would be stronger if it included concrete examples.
common_error.correct_alt: Although the author's argument is plausible, the lack of specific examples weakens the overall analysis.
common_error.explanation: Ba lokuta ya español bazali kopesa 'I think' na nzela ya directe na kozonga na ba terme oyo ezali na nguya mingi. Na anglais académique, tozali kosalela 'would', 'could', 'arguably' mpo na kopesa ba nuance na boya ba jugement ya absolu oyo ezali 'not good' (trop informel). Mpe salela 'while/although' mpo na komonisa contraste na 'would be stronger if' mpo na kopesa ba proposition ya amélioration.

levels.label: Hedging and Modality
levels.translation: Atténuation na modalité

examples.original: This may not be the most effective approach.
examples.phonetic: ðɪs meɪ nɑːt bi ðə moʊst ɪˈfɛktɪv əˈproʊtʃ
examples.translation: Approche oyo ezali ezali te ezali ya nguya mingi.
examples.note: Salela 'may' mpo na posibilité. Boya ete na español tozali kosalela 'puede que no sea', kasi na anglais tozali te kosalela subjonctif.

examples.original: The results could be interpreted in several different ways.
examples.phonetic: ðə rɪˈzʌlts kʊd bi ɪnˈtɜːrprɪtɪd ɪn ˈsɛvərəl ˈdɪfərənt weɪz
examples.translation: Ba résultat bazali kosalema na ba manière oyo ezali na différence mingi.

examples.original: It would seem that the hypothesis lacks sufficient support.
examples.phonetic: ɪt wʊd siːm ðæt ðə haɪˈpɑːθəsɪs læks səˈfɪʃənt səˈpɔːrt
examples.translation: Ezali mpo na hypothesis oyo ezali na ba soutien oyo ezali na faible.

levels.label: Evaluative Language
levels.translation: Langage ya evaluasion

examples.translation: Recherche ezali ya nouveau, kasi ezali na portée oyo ezali ya limité mingi.
examples.note: Salela 'rather' na esika ya 'muy' mpo na kopesa nuance ya négatif oyo ezali ya doux.

levels.label: Arguing and Counterarguing
levels.translation: Kosala na ba argument na ba contre-argument

examples.translation: Ata nakoti ete ba donnée ezali ya limité, nakomi ete modèle ezali mpe na valeur.
examples.note: Salela 'while' na début mpo na kopesa mokano moko na mpo na kopesa opinion na 'I maintain'.

examples.translation: Tózali kosala mokano oyo esalemi ezali na bosembo ete politique ezali ya vieux; kasi, ezali mpe na cadre oyo ezali na valeur.
examples.note: Combina 'It could be argued that' na 'however' mpo na kopesa contre-argument.

examples.translation: Ata kaka ba opposant bazali, proposition ezali mpo na kosalema na sérieux.
examples.note: Yana mpo na kosalela 'despite + noun' (te 'despite of').

title: Irony and Understatement / Ironi, sarkazm na eufemism
bridge: Na español, ironi na sarkazm mbala mpo na kopesa makomi na intonation na banzelaka ya mots (koti 'claro', 'por supuesto', 'como no'), mpe mbala mpo na kozala na ba diminutifs to ba augmentatifs. Na anglais, ironi mbala mpo na kopesa na nzela ya kopesa ton plat na ba mots ya motuna, mpe eufemism ezali eloko ya kopesa mpo na kopesa makasi ya kopesa mawa. Molongo moko ya ntina: na anglais, kobenga ('understatement') ezali nzela ya kopesa mpo na kopesa ironi (koloba 'not bad' mpo na kopesa 'excelente'), eloko oyo ba hispanohablantes mbala mpo na kolandela mawa mpe mbala mpo na kotinda na nzela ya motuna ('no está mal'), mpe kopesa molongo. Mpe boye, boye: sarkazm na anglais mbala mpo na kopesa mpo na kopesa mawa ya kopesa mawa ya kopesa mawa, mpe koposa ya ba mots ezali ya ntina mpo na kopesa mawa ya kopesa mawa.
rule: Na anglais na niveau C1, ironi na eufemism mbala mpo na kopesa na nzela ya: 1) Understatement: kozala na adjectif to adverb ya degré ya kopesa mpo na kopesa contraire (ex. 'It's not the worst idea' = 'ezali eloko ya mawa mpenza'; 'a bit' to 'slightly' na sens contraire). 2) Sarkazm: mbala mpo na kopesa na contexte na intonation (plat to exagérée), kasi mpe na ba structures koti 'Oh, great!', 'Well, that's just perfect' to 'I love it when...'. 3) Eufemism: kopesa ba termes ya motuna na ba expressions ya mawa (ex. 'passed away' na esika 'died', 'let go' na esika 'fired', 'between jobs' na esika 'unemployed', 'full-figured' na esika 'fat'). Ba formes typiques: ba adverbes ya degré ('hardly', 'barely', 'scarcely') mpo na understatement; ba questions rhétoriques ('Is that so?') mpo na ironi; ba structures na 'just', 'only', 'a bit' koti ba mitigateurs. Ba exceptions: kuna ba contextes nionso te mbala mpo na kopesa ironi; na ba situations ya formel, sarkazm ya motuna mbala mpo na kopesa. Eufemism mbala mpo na kopesa selon registre: na ba contextes ya professionnel mbala mpo na kopesa mpenza. Mpo na l'élève hispanohablante: boya kotinda na nzela ya motuna 'no está mal' (mbala mpo na kopesa koti understatement na anglais, mbala mpo na kopesa koti critique), mpe kozala na 'not too bad' to 'not bad at all' na intonation ya mawa.

concept_examples.translation: Yangó ezali moke makasi, oyebi?
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə bɪt əv ən ɪɡˌzædʒəˈreɪʃən, doʊnt juː θɪŋk/

concept_examples.text: The weather is not exactly tropical here.
concept_examples.translation: Clima na esika yangó ezali te ya tropikal.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈweðər ɪz nɒt ɪɡˈzæktli ˈtrɒpɪkəl hɪər/

concept_examples.text: He's been known to stretch the truth occasionally.
concept_examples.translation: Ye moko azali koyebisa yangó na ntina ya kopesa mawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiːz biːn noʊn tə strɛtʃ ðə truːθ əˈkeɪʒənəli/

concept_examples.text: Well, that's just perfect!
concept_examples.translation: Eh bien, yangó ezali mpenza parfait! (ironi)
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɛl, ðæts dʒʌst pərˈfɛkt/

common_error.wrong: No está mal, ¿eh? (como respuesta a algo excelente, literal translation)
common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali na kotinda na nzela ya motuna 'no está mal' na español. Na español, 'no está mal' mbala mpo na kopesa positif to négatif selon intonation, kasi na anglais 'not bad' na esika yangó moko mbala mpo na kopesa koti critique ya mawa. Mpo na kopesa understatement positif, ezali na ntina ya kosala 'at all' to kozala na 'not half bad', oyo mbala mpo na kopesa 'mpenza mawa'. Mpe boye, boye: na anglais, mbala mpo na kopesa ton plat to moke ya kopesa mpo na kopesa ironi.

levels.label: Understatement with adverbs of degree
levels.translation: Kobenga na ba adverbes ya degré

examples.original: I'm a bit confused about the instructions.

examples.translation: Nazali moke na likambo na ba instructions.
examples.note: Kuna 'a bit' mbala mpo na kopesa na ntina ya kopesa mawa, kasi na ba contextes nionso mbala mpo na kopesa ironi.

examples.original: It's a bit chilly today, isn't it? (said in a blizzard)

examples.note: Kozala na 'a bit' mpo na kopesa mpo na kopesa mawa ya kopesa mawa.

examples.translation: Ye azali te ya mawa mpenza ya kopesa organisé.
examples.note: 'Not exactly' ezali eloko ya kopesa oyo mbala mpo na kopesa ye azali mawa mpenza désorganisé.

levels.label: Sarcastic phrases and rhetorical questions
levels.translation: Ba phrases ya sarkazm na ba questions rhétoriques

examples.original: Oh, great. Another meeting on Monday morning.

examples.translation: Oh, mawa. Mokolo mosusu ya réunion na lundi na makasi.
examples.note: Sarkazm mbala mpo na kopesa na 'great' na intonation plat. Na esika ya contexte, mbala mpo na kopesa positif.

title: Indirect Speech Acts and Implicature / Baalebi ya lokola oyo ekomi na yango na ndakisa
bridge: Na espanyol, baalebi ya lokola oyo ekomi na yango na ndakisa bazali kosalema na ndakisa ya liyébá to na bato oyo bazali koyeba yango malamu. Na anglais, eloko oyo ekomi na yango na ndakisa ezali na ntina mpenza, mpo na kosala yango bazali kosalela verbes modaux (could, would), botungola oyo ezali na ndakisa, mpe kosalela temps passé (I was wondering) mpo na kopesa elongo na ndakisa. Bana ya espanyol bazali koyeba yango malamu na anglais, kasi yango ekoki kozala na ntina mpenza to kozala na ntina mpenza. Mpe, yango oyo ekomi na yango na ndakisa (boyebi) ezali na ntina mpenza; na anglais, bazali koyeba yango malamu, kasi yango ezali na ntina mpenza.
rule: Baalebi ya lokola oyo ekomi na yango na ndakisa na anglais bazali kosalema na: 1) Botungola na 'can/could/would you...' mpo na biloko oyo bazali na yango (Could you close the window?), 2) 'I was wondering if...' mpo na biloko oyo bazali na yango (I was wondering if you could help me), 3) Botungola oyo ezali na ndakisa mpo na biloko oyo bazali na yango to mpo na biloko oyo bazali na yango (Don't you think it's too late?), 4) 'It might be a good idea to...' mpo na biloko oyo bazali na yango. Mpo na yango oyo ekomi na yango na ndakisa, bazali kosalela principe ya coopération ya Grice; na ndakisa, 'I'm cold' ekoki koyeba yango malamu mpo oyebi kobenga mabanga. Na C1, bazali koyeba yango malamu mpe kozala na yango na ntina mpenza. Boye kolinga kopesa yango na ntina mpenza na espanyol; na ndakisa, '¿Puedes cerrar la ventana?' ekoki kozala na ntina mpenza 'Can you close the window?' kasi na contexte ya ntina mpenza, bazali kosalela 'Would you mind closing the window?' to 'Could you possibly close the window?'.

title: Structuring Formal Presentations / Kozonga makomami o mabotami
bridge: Na español, tozali kozanga kotambola ndaku ya mambu oyo ezali na lokuta mpo na kozonga makomami, koti 'en primer lugar', 'por otro lado' to 'en conclusión'. Na anglais, kozanga ezali mpenza na ndaku ya lokuta mpe na mbala mosusu ezali na makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza, koti 'firstly', 'furthermore', 'but more importantly', mpe 'in light of this'. Molongo moko oyo tozali kozala na yango ezali kotambola 'por un lado' na 'on one side' na esika oyo 'on the one hand' ezali na yango, to kozanga kotambola 'in conclusion' na esika oyo 'to sum up' to 'ultimately' ezali na yango. Kuna mpe, kozanga kotambola makomami na ndaku ya lokuta mpe na mbala mosusu ezali na makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza, koti 'we can see that...'. Na yango mpe, kozanga kotambola makomami na ndaku ya lokuta mpe na mbala mosusu ezali na makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza, koti 'in light of the evidence'.
rule: Na makomami o mabotami oyo ezali na anglais (C1), tozali kozanga kotambola makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza mpo na kozonga makomami na ndaku ya lokuta mpe na mbala mosusu ezali na makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza. Mpo na kozonga makomami, tozali kozanga kotambola makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza, koti 'I would like to begin by...', 'Let me start by...', to 'The purpose of this presentation is to...'. Mpo na kozonga makomami na ndaku ya lokuta mpe na mbala mosusu ezali na makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza, koti 'Firstly', 'Secondly', 'Furthermore', 'Moreover', 'In addition'. Mpo na kozonga makomami na ndaku ya lokuta mpe na mbala mosusu ezali na makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza, koti 'However', 'On the other hand', 'Nevertheless'. Mpo na kozonga makomami na ndaku ya lokuta mpe na mbala mosusu ezali na makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza, koti 'Indeed', 'In fact', 'It is important to note that'. Mpo na kozonga makomami na ndaku ya lokuta mpe na mbala mosusu ezali na makomami oyo ezali na lokuta mpenza, koti 'In conclusion', 'To summarize', 'In light of the evidence'.

title: Hedging and Boosting in Academic Writing / Libunga na kosala makasi na mokolo ya kosala makasi
bridge: Na lingala, bato basili kotosa mbula na mibeko mpo na kosala libunga, kasi na anglais académique, hedging ekomiwaka na ntina ya verbes modaux, mibeko ya probabilite na verbes ya aviseli mpo na kosala mambu mpo na 'suggest' to 'appear'. Molongo monene nde kotinda 'es posible que' mpo na 'it is possible that', oyo ekoki kasi esengi ndenge mpo na mambu mpo na 'may' to 'could'. Kasi tokoki kosala mambu mpo na kosala libunga: na anglais académique, basungi na ndenge na ntina, kasi kati na makasi ya makasi.
rule: Na mokolo ya kosala makasi na anglais, basili kotosa mbula na mibeko ya libunga (hedging) mpo na kosala mambu na mambu na kosala mambu na mambu. Mambu ya ntina nde: 1) Verbes modaux: may, might, could (p.ej., 'This may indicate...'), 2) Mibeko ya frequence/probabilite: often, sometimes, possibly, presumably (p.ej., 'This possibly suggests...'), 3) Verbes ya aviseli: suggest, appear, seem (p.ej., 'The data suggest that...'), 4) Mibeko ya ntina: it could be argued that, there is evidence to suggest. Mpo na kosala makasi (boosting), basili kotosa mbula na mibeko mpo na clearly, undoubtedly, definitively, to verbes mpo na prove, demonstrate. Ezali ya ntina te kosala mambu na mambu na libunga: mobeko mpo na 'This clearly may be true' ezali ya mbongo mpo etindaka libunga. Kosi na anglais académique formel, basili kotosa mbula na mbula 'I' na mambu mingi, basili kopesa mibeko ya ntina to ya ntina.

title: Advanced Negotiation Strategies / Stratégies ya ngombamelo ose osekoma
bridge: Na español, mpo na kosala ngombamelo, tolingi kosala lisusu na bato na ndenge ya kosala makambo na ndenge moko to na mabanga moko mpe na ndenge ya kosala makambo na ndenge moko. Na anglais, ngombamelo osekoma ezali na bosungi na verbes modales (would, could, might), na makambo ya kondisionel mpe na ndenge ya kosala makambo na ndenge moko mpo na kopesa mpe kobanda na makambo moko. Kuna mpe, anglais ezali na 'unless' mpe 'provided that' mpo na kobanda na makambo moko, oyo ezali makambo oyo esili kopesa ndenge moko na español mpe oyo ezali kozala na makambo ya kozala na ndenge moko. Kuna mpe, ezali na ndenge moko ya kosala makambo na ndenge moko na 'I was wondering if' na esika ya kosala makambo na ndenge moko, oyo na español ezali kozala na ndenge moko ya kosala makambo na ndenge moko mpe na ndenge ya kosala makambo na ndenge moko.
rule: Mpo na kosala ngombamelo na niveau C1 na anglais, boye stratégie oyo: 1) Kosala na kondisionel (first, second, third) mpo na kobanda na makambo ya kozala na ndenge moko: 'If we were to extend the deadline, we would need a discount'. 2) Verbes modales mpo na kopesa mpe kobanda na makambo moko: 'I would suggest', 'We could consider', 'I might be open to'. 3) Makambo ya kopesa mpe kobanda na makambo moko na 'although', 'however', 'while' mpo na kopesa mpe kobanda na makambo moko to makambo moko. 4) Makambo ya kopesa mpe kobanda na makambo moko mpe ya kozala na ndenge moko: 'meet you halfway', 'a win-win situation', 'bottom line'. 5) Kondisionel na 'unless', 'provided that', 'as long as' mpo na makambo ya kozala na ndenge moko: 'We can agree, provided that you cover shipping costs'. 6) Makambo ya kosala makambo na ndenge moko mpo na kozala na makambo moko: 'I was wondering if you would consider a different payment schedule'. Mpo na kozala na ndenge moko: kozala na 'I want' na esika ya kozala na ndenge moko; kozala na 'I would like' to 'We are looking for'. Exception: na makambo ya kozala na ndenge moko (hard negotiation) ezali na ndenge moko ya kozala na ndenge moko, kasi na ndenge ya kozala na ndenge moko. Boye na kozala na ndenge moko ya kozala na ndenge moko 'no me gusta' na 'I don't like it' - na anglais ezali na ndenge moko ya kozala na ndenge moko na 'I'm not entirely comfortable with that'.

title: Nuanced Expression of Attitude / Komona makasi na mosakoli
bridge: Na español, tozali komona makasi na mosakoli na nzela ya mibeko mpe makomami (mwa exemple, 'me parece que', 'a mi modo de ver'). Na anglais, lokola na mibeko, bazali kosalema mpe miteko ya modal lokola 'would', 'might', 'may' mpe makomami lokola 'I'd say' to kolanda to kosala mosakoli makasi to kobatela. Likambo moko oyo ezali na ntina ezali kozonga 'yo creo que' na 'I believe that' na minutu oyo moto oyo azali koyekola anglais azali kosalema modal to mibeko lokola 'arguably' to 'presumably'. Likambo oyo ezali kobima mingi to kozonga makasi. Likambo oyo ezali na ntina ezali koyeba ndenge ya kozala na makasi na makomami na kozala na miteko ya modal, mibeko ya makasi mpe makomami oyo ezali na moto moko te.
rule: Na anglais niveau C1, to komona makasi na mosakoli na makasi, tosalema: (1) Miteko ya modal (may, might, could, would, should) oyo ezali koloba probabilité, lokumu, molongi to eteji; (2) Mibeko ya makasi (arguably, admittedly, typically, surprisingly) oyo ezali koyeba makasi to ndenge ya kozala na moto; (3) Makomami oyo ezali na moto moko te (It's fair to say, It could be argued that) oyo ezali kobatela mosakoli; (4) Miteko ya mosakoli na makasi (I'd suggest, I'd maintain, I'd contend) na 'would' to kobatela. Na nzela ya kozala te, tosalema 'not' + 'at all', 'hardly', 'scarcely' to komona makasi. Tosengeli kozala na 'I think' to 'I believe' mingi. Na ndoko oyo ezali ya makasi, tosalema 'It would seem that' to 'It might be argued'.

title: Register Shifting / Kobenga registre suivu yango na contexte
bridge: Na español, registre ekomiwaka na nzela ya kozonga ba pronoms koti 'tú' mpe 'usted' to bango ya zunguluka ya verbes. Na anglais, registre ekomonaka te na conjugaison, kasi na likambo ya kozonga vocabulaire, structure ya ba phrases mpe kozonga voix passive to ba expressions. Bato oyo belobaka español bazongaka ntango oyo ezalaka ya solité to ya mawa mingi na ba contexte oyo ezali te ya ndenge wana, liboso na bato oyo balobaka na écrit professionnel. Ezali ya molimu mpenza tobakisa ba formules ya politesse indirecte (koti 'I was wondering if...') mpe 'hedging' ('might', 'could', 'perhaps') po tokokisa registre ya ndenge nini na ba situations ya solité.
rule:
Na anglais, registre ekokangaka suivu na contexte (solité, neutre, mawa) na nzela ya ba moyens oyo:

1. Vocabulaire: Ba mots ya solité to ya mawa (p. ex. 'purchase' vs 'buy', 'receive' vs 'get', 'child' vs 'kid').
2. Syntaxe: Ba structures ya complexe (ba phrases ya subordonnées, voix passive) ekomonisa solité mingi; ba phrases ya court mpe ya elliptique ekomonisa mawa.
3. Ba modaux mpe ba hedges: 'Would', 'could', 'might', 'perhaps', 'possibly' ekotisa ba demandes mpe ba avis na ba contexte ya solité; na ba contexte ya mawa, 'can', 'will', 'maybe' ekomiwaka.
4. Ba phrasal verbs: Ekomonanaka ndenge ya mawa to neutre; na ba registres ya solité, ba verbes ya origine latin ekomonanaka mingi (p. ex. 'to carry out' vs 'to execute').
5. Ba contractions: Ekoyokaka te na écrit ya solité ('don't' ekoyokaka te kasi 'do not' ndenge nioni).
6. Ba formules ya fixe: Na ba lettres mpe ba courriels ya solité, ba formules ya ndenge wana ekomiwaka ('Dear Sir/Madam', 'Yours faithfully').
7. Ba pronoms: Ata soki ezali te distinction ya solité ndenge 'tú/usted', kozonga 'one' na nzela ya 'you' ekomonisa ton ya impersonnel mpe ya solité (p. ex. 'One must consider...').

Ba exceptions: Anglais ya britannique ezali ya solité mingi na kozonga ba formules kolanda anglais ya américain. Na communication numérique ya mawa, ezali makasi kozonga ba mots ya court mpe ba emoticonnes, kasi na ba contexte ya professionnel, toyokana yango. Registre ezali te na vocabulaire nioni, kasi na intonation mpe politesse pragmatique, ndenge kozonga 'please' mpe 'thank you' mingi kolanda español.

common_error.wrong: Yes, I can help you with your project tomorrow, definitely.
common_error.correct: Yes, I would be happy to help you with your project tomorrow.
common_error.correct_alt: Certainly, I can help you with your project tomorrow.
common_error.explanation: Soko ya mabe ezali kozonga 'definitely' mpe structure ya ndenge wana ya directe na ba contexte ya solité. Bato oyo belobaka español bazalaka na ndenge ya mawa mingi mpe bazongaka ba adverbes ya forte koti 'definitely' na ba situations oyo anglais epengaka ba formules ya politesse mpe ya douce. Na courrier ya solité to réunion ya travail, 'definitely' ezali kozua ndenge ya forte mingi. Tokoki kozonga 'I would be happy to' (nazali na mawa kozua) to 'Certainly' (ndenge nioni) oyo ekomonisa politesse mpe registre ya ndenge nioni.

title: Pragmatic Styles in Cross-Cultural Communication / Baninga ya ntoma na ndembi ya lokola na lokola
bridge: Na espanyol, mbote na kozonga kozonga ekomana na bango ya makasi (kombo ya kondisional, mikanda ya kobondela, makasi). Na anglais, kasi na mikanda ya komonisa na mikanda ya komonisa, bakomi na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala. Basangisangi ya espanyol bazali na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala, mpe na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala. Makasi: 'maybe' ezali 'baje el tono'; 'I think' na anglais ekomana na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala.
rule: Na anglais, mbote ya ntoma ekomana na bango ya makasi: 1) Hedges ('sort of', 'kind of', 'I'd say'), 2) Verbos modales na lokola (would, could, might) mpo na kopesa ntina, 3) Boyokani ya sika to bangota ('couldn't we...?'), 4) Mikanda ya mbote na 'I'm afraid', 'I'd rather'. Na espanyol, mbote ekomana na kondisional ('me gustaría', 'podrías'), kasi bazali na ntina ya kozala na ntina ya kozala. Na kozonga kozonga, basangisangi ya anglais bazali na ntina ya kozala na 'I see your point, but...' lokola mikanda ya kobondela, mpe na espanyol 'no estoy de acuerdo' ezali mbote. Mpo na C1, boye 'just' mpe 'actually' lokola bangota ya kozala na mbote.

Moto azali na eloko ya kozala na 'I see your point' to 'I'm afraid' mpo na kozala na ntina ya kozala. Boya boyokani ya sika; kombo bangota mpe bangota.

examples.note: 'I might be wrong' ezali eloko ya kozala na ntina ya kozala oyo ezali na ntina ya kozala; ekomana mpo na kozala na ntina ya kozala mpe ya mbotama.
